templates.why_chosen: Star-rated: an offset stack of Pod 0/1/N cards (replication) sits inside a dashed Data-Plane box, wired by a bottom legend's orange data-flow and blue control-flow arrows to a separate dashed Control-Plane box.
templates.what_to_learn: Box the data plane and control plane as two separate dashed regions, use an offset card stack (Pod 0/1/N) to show replication inside the data-plane box without drawing every pod, and put a two-color arrow legend below to name data flow versus control flow.
